slug: 2026-07-09 NIMC Enrols 136 Million Nigerians as Coker-Odusote Pushes Stronger Inter-Ministerial Partnership

systems.country_label: National Identity Database; nationwide ward-level enrolment
systems.tiers: over 136 million enrolled; ward-level enrolment begun nationwide; the information minister urges mobilisation through the National Orientation Agency, which has offices in all 774 local government areas

note: National identity enrolment by a federal commission: the offices in the 774 local government areas are a federal agency's, not the local governments' own; nothing on local government offices or their connection.
